payload.text: ST0011/02 (WP02c), THE CI KEYS AND THE CHECKER, vc's choice (b), after dc's WP03 remainder and WP17 land (vc's earlier rulings that name WP02b for these read WP02c): ci.wait's default 60m (lib/config:549 says 20m) with its doc line and an arm reading it; ci.query defaulting to the built-in, ci.workflow and ci.summary refused only beside a bespoke query, a release block of ci keys alone valid; is_branch_name in lib/helpers (git check-ref-format refs/heads/<name>) with its three sites, lib/cmd/release's two and ci-state's; the --fires call lines, bin/devbin ci-state --fires <ref> <sha> [<path>...]: the pre-flight passes HEAD, the candidate ref and the stamp's files (the version file, its sidecars, the notes file), release check the next cut's, each refusing on anything but fires with the reader's reason, force the override; a bespoke ci.query is not asked (cfg_ci_query_is_builtin), release check printing that the trigger is that query's to read; ci-state's failed line, run <id> (<conclusion>; failed jobs: a, b), printed verbatim; AC-6.3 under D69, the pre-flight refusing a gate active on none of the cut's legs, naming the gate and its platforms (WP17's platforms: predicate).
